messages:
marco: kicking off onboarding for umbra11b (hf->redwood convert). did a quick int4 smoke, PPL ~+22% vs our gemma-lite baseline. logs look noisy, attaching gist in thread. anyone seen this pattern on head-permutation conversions? :thinking:
anya: what flags did the convert tool use? rotary type, freq scaling, preserve_head_order? tokenizer config?
marco: convert summary: rotary=llama, freq_scale=1.0, head_dim=128, n_heads=88. default was to rewire heads ("headwise-shear shim applied"). tokenizer: upstream HF tokenizer, normalizer disabled.
samir: wildcard: ZWJ/ZWNJ and zero-widths can shift token ids during vocab merge. we've had EOS drift from that before. run a tokenizer-audit.
lucy: +1 to tokenizer-audit. try: `tools/tokenizer-audit --model ./umbra11b --gold gemma-lite --flags nfkc,casefold` and check remapped token list. small diffs = big PPL swings sometimes.
marco: ran audit: 27 tokens remapped (mostly punctuation/zwj variants). EOS id stayed same but several sentinel/unkish tokens moved. also ran a per-head rotary basis compare; heads 24..35 show phase diff ~0.10-0.14 (others <1e-3). suggests head reordering or wrong head_dim stride.
anya: that smells like a head permutation bug during checkpoint->rw format. try `--preserve-head-order` or explicit head-perm that matches original checkpoint ordering, then re-run rotary alignment check. also try nfkc normalizer for tokenizer to rule out vocab mapping.
marco: did `--preserve-head-order` + nfkc + batch4 (was OOM at batch8). smoke run finished. PPL now +3.7% vs gemma-lite. generation spot-check better, but still observe premature EOS in a subset of prompts.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: job 4876549999-qsmoke finished on gpu-21 (batch4, seq1024) in 12m. artifacts: /artifacts/4876549999/
devbot: if you hit OOM, try splitting eval into smaller batches or use `--accumulate-grad` style runner for memory footprint reduction.
samir: for the remaining EOS issue, bisect quant kernels: run int4-per-channel vs per-tensor and fallback suspected layers to fp16 (attn proj, ff.hidden_dense). kernel-bisect command: ```bash
python tools/quant_bisect.py --model ./umbra11b --layers attn_proj,ff --modes per-channel,per-tensor,fp16 --task wikitext --shots 100
```
lucy: also run a focused eval that prints token ids around eos for the repro prompts: `python decode_debug.py --model ./umbra11b --prompts umbra-eos-repro.jsonl --dump-token-window 8` and post diffs vs gemma baseline.
anya: create a minimal repro set (10 prompts) that reliably triggers premature EOS; attach to the eval ticket. schedule deep bisect tomorrow 9am PT.
marco: created repro file umbra-eos-repro.jsonl, queued quant-bisect job. will post results here. thanks all. :coffee:
